proposal.hypothesis: The current policy ranks purely by failure_rate, which repeatedly selects memory (highest failure_rate) despite its recent gain, starving exploration of other modules with real defects (recovery, prompt, tools). A composite score that combines failure_rate with stagnation and a small exploration bonus for unattempted modules will diversify proposals and surface remaining real defects, while still prioritizing high-failure modules.
